# Kennedy Executive Travel

> Premier chauffeur service based in Central Scotland, covering Glasgow, Edinburgh, Fife, the Lothians and surrounding areas. Offers VIP, executive and group vehicle hire with professional chauffeurs.

## About
Kennedy Executive Travel provides chauffeur-driven vehicle hire for airport transfers, weddings, VIP transportation, corporate travel, private tours, golf days, concerts and events, and group travel (proms, hen/stag parties). Based in Central Scotland with over 100 five-star customer reviews.

## Services
- Airport transfers (all UK airports, flight tracking, meet & greet)
- Wedding chauffeur services (VIP to standard, full-day planning)
- VIP transportation (discreet, high-profile, corporate)
- Golfing transfers
- Concerts & events
- Private tours of Central Scotland
- Corporate travel & account work
- Proms & parties (groups up to 16)

## Fleet
- VIP Range: Rolls-Royce Ghost (from £349, newest addition), Bentley Flying Spur (from £299, new addition), Mercedes G63 AMG (from £149), Mercedes Maybach (from £199), Audi SQ7 (from £149)
- Executive Range: Mercedes V-Class, Mercedes C-Class, Porsche Cayenne S (from £89)
- Mini Buses: 8/12/14-seat mini buses and Ford Transit 17-seater (from £79)

## Coverage
Glasgow, Edinburgh, Central Scotland, Fife, the Lothians, and all UK airports. Long-distance journeys available on request.
